user_reported_bug: Second occurrence of the SAME failure class — loop_bff, same 'LLM produced no usable file content' error, similar broad multi-file task on archived sentinel/evolver/clawchief routers. Additionally, 3 NEW UI-state bugs visible in this screenshot: 1. After the loop reaches FAIL (terminal state), the top progress-stepper still shows EXECUTE as active/orange, not failed/red. 2. The 'Agent is running…' banner (Iter 284 queue-status bar) still displays AFTER the terminal FAIL state — this needs to clear the instant a terminal event (completed/failed/aborted) arrives. 3. The heartbeat fallback line ('~ Execute in progress...') is still rendering SIMULTANEOUSLY with the FAIL message above it — these should be mutually exclusive. Once a terminal event exists, the heartbeat/fallback line must not render at all.

rca_of_the_issue: Verified fix addresses the suspected root cause: terminal frames synchronously set loopTerminalRef/setBusy(false)/setLoopTerminal(true), so later non-terminal SSE frames are ignored and heartbeat/gap UI is suppressed after terminal. MOCKED SSE sequence included execute heartbeat, failed, then late executing frame; DOM stayed failed and not busy.
